RELEASE RECEIPTS — 0.12.0 shipped 2026-08-15 (all channels verified):
- Gerrit change 1825: LLM-Review +1 (rebar review bot), Verified +1 (rebar CI bot), 0 unresolved; submitted (Rebase-If-Necessary) -> main commit b0aac2314b63fc937b3f1d7d638a97609782e954.
- Full local suite green after root-causing the earlier failures as harness-injected GIT_CONFIG safe.bareRepository=explicit (see prior comment): 13525 passed, 0 failed.
- release.yml run 31916566035 (dispatch-from-main, version=0.12.0): all 10 jobs success (authorize/lockstep/ancestry/env-preflight, build-once, wheel_test, sdist_test, evidence, Publish to PyPI, Publish to MCP Registry, Create GitHub Release). NOTE: a first dispatch (run 31916489765) failed closed in authorize as designed — it raced the Gerrit->GitHub main replication; re-dispatch after replication succeeded. The pypi environment approval was granted by the configured release identity (JoeOakhartNava) via POST .../pending_deployments; docs follow-up nosophobic-towcolored-kouprey corrects the 'second human approval' framing.
- PyPI: nava-rebar 0.12.0 live (wheel 6dd63ea6bd59c498…, sdist 61a62efa4a58bbe6…); PEP 740 attestation verify OK (uvx pypi-attestations verify pypi --repository https://github.com/navapbc/rebar … 0.12.0 wheel).
- GitHub: tag v0.12.0 = b0aac2314b…; Release v0.12.0 is Latest with wheel + sdist + SHA256SUMS attached.
- MCP Registry: io.github.navapbc/rebar 0.12.0 listed.
- Homebrew: autobump run 31917337582 success; Formula/rebar.rb url -> nava_rebar-0.12.0.tar.gz, sha256 61a62efa4a58bbe64eebd144463d54c2ce40818ac402a8c914c66555852f17bd == PyPI sdist digest.
- Channel smoke test: pipx install 'nava-rebar[mcp]==0.12.0' --force; scripts/probe_rebar.py -> PROBE RESULT: 142 passed, 0 failed.
- Rollback disposition: nothing to roll back; no yank, no de-list. Discovered work filed: peach-chemic-hairstreak (Bedrock region config), nosophobic-towcolored-kouprey (release-docs approval framing). A pre-existing duplicate-[Unreleased] CHANGELOG defect was repaired in the release commit itself.
